name: wai-suite
description: Sustainable software product development with Claude Code: 13 skills for the engineering lifecycle — plan, build, test, review, audit — built to keep architecture maintainable and clean and security first-class while agents write the code. The working premise, drawn from field runs: even frontier models lose context, are confident when wrong, and forget rules — so nothing here relies on the model remembering; each goal gets a gate, a rule, or a deterministic check, and whether a PR may merge is decided by a script with an exit code and, above it, a human. Ships the merge gate, the quality-catalog system (one master, three generated variants), 29 enforcement scripts and 401 cases, founded on bugs that shipped and grown into regression guards.
